data_staging_reason: The fixed-time OSM raw response is retained outside Git and receipt/hash-bound to locally normalized candidate geometry. Official PDF, hazard, facility, and PLATEAU contracts are excluded.
geometry_connection_reason: Candidate OSM VGI geometry is not rendered and has no field or administrative validation.
hazard_connection_reason: No hash-bound official hazard geometry is in the accepted P0 subset.
plateau_connection_reason: No hash-bound PLATEAU raw snapshot or verified corridor coverage is retained.
model_connection_reason: No candidate edge has the complete source-traceable M7 inputs.

physically_reachable.reason: Candidate topology lacks verified entrances and M6 profile evaluation.

accommodated.reason: Traceable demand, usable capacity, and operation are unavailable.

overflow_waiting.reason: Traceable demand, usable capacity, and operation are unavailable.

unreachable.reason: Traceable demand origins and M6 profile evaluation are unavailable.

unknown_affected_upper_bound.reason: No connected official hazard geometry is converted to closure or passability.
